title: 2025 Reunion - Ventures Panel: Costa Farms and Metromont
description:
On this year's Ventures panel at the 2025 Reunion, we welcomed the CEOs of two of our Markel Ventures businesses. Andrew Crowley (President of Markel Ventures) moderated the panel with Joche Smith (CEO of Costa Farms), and Rick Pennell (CEO of Metromont). 

Not often are ornamental plants and pre-cast concrete mentioned in the same sentence. So, what do these two businesses have in common? More than you think. This panel discussed how two third-generation, family-led businesses became market leaders through an uncommon commitment to long-term values. They explored the history of their companies, their decision to partner with Markel Group, and what it takes to carry on their longstanding tradition of "winning".

Learn more about the Reunion at MKLReunion.com
